newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street opens lower on GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street opens lower on GDP data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened lower Wednesday after a sharp jump in U.S. real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for the first quarter.
Analysts said the 5.6 percent annual rise -- the greatest increase for the quarter in nine years -- could help prompt the U.S. central bank to raise interest rates next month.
The markets also could be weighed by profit-taking after a big rise Tuesday, they said.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was off 15/32 to yield 7.02 percent after release of the figures. The Standard & Poors 500 index was off 2.41 to 791.64.
